name: o90339

schema.title: Visual Variable Legend Options
schema.description: Options available for the legend for visual variables.

showLegend.description: Indicates whether to show the color/size/opacity ramp in the legend.

description: The map will include a visible legend titled **Population Density Legend**, which will be displayed alongside the layers. The legend’s ramp is configured to show custom breakpoints at the following values: 0, 5.5, 10, 20, and 30.
